rationale: Record an embedded-editor keyboard-routing change that crosses this family's core/view/** selector without touching anything the family is about. A plugin editor shares one keyboard with its DAW, and the macOS seam reported every key handled once a text field held focus — so a Command/Control chord or a function key the field declined never reached the host, for as long as a type-in happened to be open. The fix adds core/view/src/plugin_key_routing.cpp, a format-neutral policy that asks the view tree who consumes a key (an open overlay's Escape, then the focused view under this root, then root.on_global_key) and forwards anything none of them claimed; the macOS -keyDown: path and VST3's IPlugView::onKeyDown both consume it. It touches input routing and first-responder handling only: no renderer, canvas, Skia, Graphite, Dawn, resource, or asset implementation changes, no paint or layout path, and no threading prescription. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
tests: tools/scripts/confirm_failure.sh on both the policy and the macOS seam: CONFIRMED
